scope: Native microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T hostile control on the same frozen 1016-token protocol. Tests whether exact RMS restoration alone explains the Gate003 advantage.

effects.note: The latter uses the Gate003 matched dynamic A4 NLL 4.749722987413406 as reference; separate-run low-level differences mean it is descriptive rather than a paired single-run estimate.

interpretation.radial_effect: Exact RMS restoration improves the ordinary dynamic A4 family, so preserving radius is itself useful.
interpretation.angular_effect: Exact RMS restoration does not close the gap. Fixed/shared angular coding of normalized direction remains 0.32657 NLL better under the hostile-control rule.
interpretation.next_gate: Find the minimum radial precision that preserves the A4 advantage on native BitNet, preferably with cascaded calibration on quantized upstream trajectories; do not return to A3/A2 until the radial codec is controlled.
